protocol_notes: Development runs full online plus offline separately on each of four tasks; pooled public-history replay chooses one task-independent policy for final evaluation.
Final evaluation fixes policy and disables offline revision; no final private score returns to any search or selection.
Development and final share each task's API and execution budget. Failed attempts and rejected responses count.
Public validation scores are candidate-reported; identity and metric are checked, scores are not universally recomputed.
Single seed pilot. Development4, remaining18, all22 are reported separately. Remaining18 have prior baseline observations and are not pristine blind tests.
Four task lanes with disjoint two-core CPU groups; candidates and paid generation serialized per task. GPU devices are exclusively leased from 4-7.
Native v26 cumulative any-node best-first plus virtual replay retained; shortened rounds and no hyperparameter/counterfactual tuning for first bounded pilot.
